task.title: Motor Bogie Maintenance — Periodic Inspection
task.shortdesc: Visual and clearance inspection procedure every 25,000 km.

context.p: This procedure describes the checks on the primary suspension, the dampers and the axlebox fastening.

step.cmd: Visually inspect the primary suspension springs for cracks.
Check the tightening torque of the axlebox bolts set to 120 Nm.
Measure the clearance with the feeler gauge (nominal 0.05 mm).

result.note: A test run is mandatory before returning the unit to service.
result.p: Threshold expression: clearance > 0.15 mm => replace bushing.
